annotation_description_on_image: two white stars marking points of contact between EMCV IRES and 60S subunit
from_the_caption: (B) Closeup view on a steric clash between the EMCV IRES and the 60S subunit.

annotation_description_on_image: white star with on-image text label "Clash" marking the steric clash site
red X mark over the reaction arrow indicating the blocked pathway
from_the_caption: (D) On the right, formation of the 80S complex is prevented by a steric clash between the 40S-bound EMCV IRES (red) and the 60S subunit. Release of the EMCV IRES is required to prevent this clash.

annotation_description_on_image: leader line/arrow with on-image text label "Met-tRNAi Met" pointing to the tRNA density
from_the_caption: (H) Zoomed-in view of the ribosomal positioning of initiator tRNA bound to the EMCV IRES and eIF2α in 48S initiation complexes.

annotation_description_on_image: leader line/arrow with on-image text label "Met-tRNAi Met" pointing to the tRNA density
from_the_caption: (I) Close-up of the ribosomal positioning of initiator tRNA and eIF5B in 40S ribosomal complexes in the process of subunit joining.

annotation_description_on_image: distance mark with on-image text label "16.7 Å" and small yellow star indicating the shifted tRNA position
from_the_caption: (J) Superimposition of (H) and (I) showing a 16.7 Å shift in the position of tRNA, which leads to (K) steric interference between the tRNA T-loop and the C548 residue...

annotation_description_on_image: yellow star with leader line and on-image text label "C548" marking the clashing residue
from_the_caption: ...steric interference between the tRNA T-loop and the C548 residue of the EMCV IRES tetraloop-containing subdomain after eIF2 is replaced by eIF5B, disrupting the stable tetraloop-tRNA contact.
